sections.adaptation: Original four directional two-pixel display edges and greater-than-200ms uninterrupted dwell without held mouse buttons; fold-transfer-reveal in the existing Dock spring/surface owner and existing speed/reduced-motion policy. Reuses one Dock HWND and icon owner, closes transient surfaces, recomputes destination DPI/work-area/profile geometry and migrates cooperative reservations; no second Dock, input hook or worker. An 80ms UI timer exists only for enabled follow mode with multiple connected outputs; refuses foreign-motion/input/fullscreen-target conflicts. Existing config stores the last display ID and preserves independent Stage placement; synthetic injected-topology hosted evidence remains separate from physical mixed-DPI interaction.

Original nonactivating SetWindowPos topmost behavior, explicit marker-before-mutation and synchronous foreign enable on existing pool. Existing single detached Guardian, process-birth identity, pending-begin acknowledgement, distinct lease kind/key, exact-bit restoration and startup orphan recovery. Refuses pre-existing topmost, elevated, Shell, owned targets and owner groups with pre-existing topmost popups. Adds native Dock/Control Center routes and opt-in Ctrl+Win+T with vi/en/zh Settings; no global policy, permanent worker or reassertion against another app.

Reference-only unlocked-session shelf in existing native Control Center, not Dynamic Notch. Original CF_HDROP/HDROP handling, case-insensitive deduplication, atomic maximum-200 admission, Shell IDataObject and copy/move/link drag completion semantics. Real drag starts only after a row crosses Windows drag thresholds; keyboard can copy Shell references. RAII OLE/drop registration, disconnected targets and session clear; no new thread/poll loop. Original six-item thumbnail layout remains a fidelity gap.

Retain Shell item/context binding and canonical Uninstall verb discovery; scoped COM/menu/subclass lifetime; native Windows menu on Spotlight thread to preserve Dock-only ownership of imported single-threaded D2D factory; existing TLauncher organization and pin actions remain. No direct uninstall command parsing.

Same normal WinRT radio and DDC/CI APIs, on existing transient utility worker; typed scoped activation factories, consent and result checks, per-device stale-state checks, monitor identity captured at gesture, actual native readback, physical-handle RAII and no optimistic success. Original permanent Sistema worker is not started.

Hexadecimal SSID in a temporary manual open-network XML profile; revalidate clicked interface and refuse a saved or newly secured network; preserve existing known-profile path and Windows credential UI; TEST builds remain read-only.
